periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high width-to-height ratio along the primary axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering with the lowest point positioned significantly below and medial to the geometric center.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial edges of the ears is approximately equivalent to the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded apex curvature with minor peripheral irregularities due to fur texture.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible sharp, white claws on the forepaws used for grasping bamboo stalks.
